summary: Excuse me brushes the fingertips of one hand across the palm of the other, twice. Use it to get past someone, to interrupt, or to apologize for something small.
movement: Dominant fingertips brush off the end of the other palm twice
steps: Hold your non-dominant hand flat, palm up.
Brush the fingertips of your dominant hand across the palm and off the fingertips, twice.
A small lean forward or nod makes it polite.
mistakes: Sliding the whole hand across. Only the fingertips brush.

faq.q: Is EXCUSE-ME the same as SORRY?
faq.a: No. SORRY is a fist circling on the chest, for real apologies. EXCUSE-ME is for getting past, interrupting, or small things.
